terms.definition: A potential difference is induced across a conductor when it moves relative to a magnetic field or when the field around it changes.
A generator that produces alternating current, with slip rings.
terms.examiner: Separate Physics, higher tier. A dynamo uses a split-ring commutator for dc.

terms.definition: Uses the generator effect: sound waves move a coil in a magnetic field, inducing a varying p.d.
Two coils on an iron core: an ac in the primary coil makes a changing field that induces an ac in the secondary coil.
terms.examiner: Separate Physics, higher tier. Vₚ / Vₛ = nₚ / nₛ.
